title: Delivery modality (how it enters the body)
principle: One small shared enum for medications, supplements, and exogenous hormones. Describes route only — not dose, not efficacy, not PK curves. Prefer coarse classes over brand devices.
anti_patterns: Do not build a full PK/PD simulator per route
Do not equate oral vitamin D with injectable as the same teaching effect
Do not treat IV as 'stronger nutrition' automatically
Do not invent infusion rates or implant release schedules

modalities.label: Oral (by mouth)
modalities.packet_hint: May co-travel with food packet; first-pass / matrix relevant

modalities.label: Intravenous (IV)
modalities.note: Bypasses gut entirely — not a food-packet absorption story

modalities.label: Pellet / subcutaneous implant
modalities.note: Long-acting depot — app only stores that it is onboard, not release kinetics

domains.supplement: Dietary supplements, vitamins, herbals, sport nutraceuticals
domains.hormone: Exogenous hormone therapy (HRT, TRT, thyroid Rx as med class, etc.) — OPEN self-report

process_hints.gi_channel: May interact with meal matrix, bile, first-pass (L2 packet stories)
process_hints.parenteral_or_skin: Bypasses oral absorption laws for that agent — still coach food quality separately
process_hints.never: Do not auto-score 'IV vitamins absorb better than food' as a Court claim
